_about: What the pipeline asks the Census Data API for. Loaded by sources/acs.ts (fetch) and normalize/acs.ts (turn rows into GeoProfile). Each measure is the sum of the listed ACS 5-year variables; labels were checked to mean the same thing in the 2016 and 2024 surveys.

measureNotes.cvap: Citizens 18+: native-born plus naturalized, men plus women (B05003). Table B29001 would be simpler but doesn't exist in the 2016 survey.
measureNotes.bachelorsOrHigher: Bachelor's, master's, professional and doctorate degrees, out of adults 25+ (B15003).
measureNotes.medianHouseholdIncome: In dollars of the survey's final year, so 2016 and 2024 values aren't directly comparable.

09.why: From the 2022 survey on, Connecticut is reported by 9 planning regions instead of its 8 counties, and the map and election results still use the counties. The 2017–2021 survey is the last with county figures; medians like income can't be rebuilt by adding towns.
